summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of Dapper Den (guest journey). Home, Men/Women/Kids category hubs, PLPs, PDP, size-required error, add-to-cart, cart, coupon validation (DAPPER10/STREET20/FLAT300 + invalid), checkout 3-step flow with address validation & payment methods, order confirmation with order id, and search were all tested successfully via the public URL. No JS errors thrown. One test-only wrong path (/men/tees vs /men/t-shirts) revealed that navbar/category slug is 't-shirts' — this is correct in the app and the actual navigation from CategoryHub works. Coupons verified via UI and direct API curl.

issues: Guest visitors trigger repeated /api/auth/me 401 requests visible in the console. Consider skipping the call when no token is present or downgrading logs — functional impact: none.

action_items: (Optional/low) Suppress or gate /api/auth/me polling for guests to avoid noisy 401s in console.

(Optional) Add data-testid attributes to key elements (Add to Bag, size buttons, coupon input, Continue to Payment, Place Order) — currently only text/CSS selectors are usable which slows automated tests.
critical_code_review_comments: No data-testid attributes present in shipping code (constants exist in /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds/ but are unused). Adds friction to future automated regression.

Checkout order_id is generated on the client via Math.random and only replaced from backend when user is logged in — for guest orders this is acceptable per spec but there is no persistence path; user cannot 'Track Order' as guest.
PLP filter path uses category slug 't-shirts' (correct) — no bug, but consider redirecting common aliases (tees->t-shirts) for URL robustness.
Cart 'msg' state is not cleared on successful apply after a prior invalid attempt in some race conditions — minor UX polish.
seed_data_creation: None. Catalog is served from memory by backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary guest flows pass end-to-end. Navbar dropdowns not deeply exercised (hover-based mega-menu) — future tests should verify hover interactions. Auth login (Emergent Google) not tested per instructions. When adding automated tests, prefer to add data-testid to Add-to-Bag, size chips (h-11 w-14 buttons), coupon input/apply, checkout Continue/Place Order.
